integrity: All stated infinite-quantifier conclusions follow from the analytic moment, step-reduction and derivative argument; rational computations are supplementary and independent historical-priority verification has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional real distributional BV, arbitrary finite mesh of positive cell lengths, unweighted Lebesgue L2 projection to discontinuous cellwise affine functions, and integrated L1 error; no higher degree, weights or multivariate claim.
title: Sharp integrated bounded-variation error of cellwise affine orthogonal projection
